name: The Idaho Foodbank Volunteer Shifts
what_you_do: Sort donated food, repack bulk food into family size bags, label cans and build backpack food inserts. Shifts are in a warehouse.
who_can_apply: Volunteers ages 8 and up. Volunteers 15 and younger must be with an adult volunteer. Each person makes their own account.
duration: Shifts are booked in advance (length not stated on the program page)
deadline_text: No deadline. Book a shift any time.
how_to_apply: Make an account and book a shift in the VolunteerHub system. Wear closed-toe, closed-heel shoes. Download the minor waiver if you are under 18.
notes: The warehouse is not heated or cooled, so wear layers. Groups of more than 18 use the group request form.
